metadata.title: NanoDrop One Nucleic Acid Quantification
metadata.purpose: Measure purified dsDNA, ssDNA, or RNA concentration and absorbance purity ratios using a NanoDrop One instrument.
metadata.scope: Pedestal or cuvette measurements using the NanoDrop One Nucleic Acids application; the linked user guide's microvolume procedure uses 1–2 µL.

materials.name: Blanking solution
materials.specification: Use the same buffer used to resuspend the analyte, with similar pH and ionic strength.

materials.name: Purified dsDNA, ssDNA, or RNA sample

tables.title: Values reported for dsDNA, ssDNA, and RNA measurements
rows: Concentration reported for the selected application.

steps.action: Lift the NanoDrop One arm and clean the upper and lower pedestals with a new laboratory wipe.
steps.safetyNotes: Do not use a squirt or spray bottle near the instrument, and do not use hydrofluoric acid on the pedestals.

steps.action: From the Home screen, select the Nucleic Acids tab and select dsDNA, ssDNA, or RNA; specify baseline correction if desired.
Apply blanking solution to the lower pedestal and lower the arm, then start the Blank measurement.

parameters.rawText: Pipette 1–2 µL blanking solution onto the lower pedestal.

steps.action: Clean both pedestals, apply sample to the pedestal, lower the arm, and start measurement according to the Auto-Measure setting.

parameters.rawText: Pipette 1–2 µL sample solution onto the pedestal.

repeat.notes: Clean the pedestals before the next sample measurement.

steps.expectedResult: The instrument displays the spectrum and reported values in table t1.

steps.action: Review the reported values, end the experiment when measurements are complete, and clean both pedestals.

limitations: Sample identity, blank composition, and acceptance criteria are experiment-specific and are not selected in this link-derived record.
